maxPoints.title: Maximum points
maxPoints.description: Together with the points per word this sets how many words each player gets (10 ÷ 2 = 5 words).

pointsPerWord.title: Points per word
pointsPerWord.description: Earned for every word a player slipped into a conversation unnoticed.

customWords.title: Your own words (optional)
customWords.description: One per line or separated by commas. Below: use them instead of the built-in list of about 1,400 English words, or together with it. Instead: make it at least players × words long, or some players will share words.

customWordsChance.title: Chance the next word is one of yours (%)
customWordsChance.description: Together with the built-in list: how likely each new word comes from your words (while some are left). 100 = all of yours first, then the built-in ones.
